what: referee validation: Spark (GB10) lv-engine, Q8_0 weights, one-pass scoring (the referee) and token by token, vs Hugging Face transformers 5.22.1 in BF16 on an A100 80GB (Vast.ai), teacher-forced on 24 honest greedy replies of up to 256 tokens generated on the Spark
verdict: both referees as close to the reference implementation as decoding; the remaining gap is Q8_0 vs BF16. Cost $0.59.
